name: Cocaethylene
summary: Cocaethylene (ethylbenzoylecgonine) is the ethyl ester of benzoylecgonine. It is structurally similar to cocaine, which is the methyl ester of benzoylecgonine. Cocaethylene is formed by the liver in small amounts when cocaine and ethanol coexist in the blood. Cocaethylene was first synthesized in 1885; its side effects were identified in 1989.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a serotonin-norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitor (SNDRI), with stimulant and euphoriant properties.

uses.routes: Produced from ingestion of cocaine and ethanol

uses.en: It has no medical use. It forms in the body and is measured in forensic and medical testing.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途。它會在體內生成，並在法醫與醫學檢驗中被測量。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途。它会在体内生成，并在法医与医学检验中被测量。

sideEffects.en: It has stimulant effects like cocaine and stays in the body longer. It is thought to be more harmful to the heart and liver than cocaine, with a raised risk of heart attack, dangerous heart rhythms and sudden death.
sideEffects.zh: 它具有類似古柯鹼的興奮作用，且在體內停留更久。一般認為它對心臟與肝臟的傷害比古柯鹼更大，會提高心臟病發作、危險心律不整與猝死的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它具有类似古柯碱的兴奋作用，且在体内停留更久。一般认为它对心脏与肝脏的伤害比古柯碱更大，会提高心脏病发作、危险心律不整与猝死的风险。

fact.en: Cocaethylene is cocaine with its methyl ester swapped for an ethyl ester, a difference of just one carbon atom. It was first made in a laboratory in 1885.
fact.zh: 高古柯鹼是把古柯鹼的甲酯換成乙酯，兩者只差一個碳原子。它在 1885 年首次於實驗室中合成。
fact.zhHans: 高古柯碱是把古柯碱的甲酯换成乙酯，两者只差一个碳原子。它在 1885 年首次于实验室中合成。
